bindings.variant: measure; AdpfSwipeDecodeBoost (PerformanceHintManager session on LibreBoardLiveSwipe, 100 ms target, reportActualWorkDuration after each decode) enabled only by the harness in alternating 50-row blocks

findings: preferredUpdateRateNanos 83,333,330 on GrapheneOS 2026100201; the public SDK 36 API has no sendHint, so the boost relies on reported durations against the target.

Hint on vs off: fused_swipe p50/p95 121.1/221.1 vs 162.2/234.4 ms, rows over 200 ms 17 vs 42, decode p95 198.3 vs 212.3 ms, fused starts on a little core 44% vs 72%, fused mid-core clock p50 1795 vs 820 MHz.
All five on blocks beat both neighbouring off blocks. Off rows right after an on block show no carryover (80% little starts) and the first rows of an on block are already boosted.
Block 0 ran before any session existed and was already faster than the same rows in grapheneos-placement-500-1 (162 vs 201 ms p50): that is device-state drift, not a boost effect.

Every row still over 200 ms with the hint on is a decode over 150 ms that woke on a little core; the fusion tail is involved in 4 of 17. Per-arm accuracy differs only through row mix (standalone CTC, which the hint never touches, differs by the same amount); whole-run fused top-1/top-3 is unchanged at 87.2%/93.4%.
limitations: Diagnostic only; releaseEligible is false. The measure APK (non-debuggable, testOnly, ART speed) is not the pinned debugNoMinify APK, and the swipe model is a candidate, not the pinned model.
Swipe shard 1/3 of build/model-data/swipe-latin-v1/test.jsonl, first rows only; every run here replays the same row ids, so cross-run comparisons share rows but not device state.
Cross-run drift is about ±10% in CPU time (phone temperature 34–38 °C across the session); arm comparisons within one run are the reliable ones.

The instrumentation process runs in the /foreground cpuset (cores 0–6, no big core) and AOSP Instrumentation runs the harness thread at nice −8 (THREAD_PRIORITY_URGENT_DISPLAY). A visible IME may be scheduled differently; a live-keyboard measurement is still owed.
latencyMs times the suggestion call only, not end-to-end IME latency. Each row also runs standalone geometric (1500 ms budget) and standalone CTC before fused_swipe.

CtcDecodeTrace placement probes read /proc and sysfs at decode start and end; that adds about 5 ms to fused_swipe (slot-plus-decoder overhead 1.8 → 6.7 ms p50), so absolute fused_swipe latencies here read slightly high.
50-row blocks alternate off/on, so the two arms hold different row ids.
scope: Diagnostic 500-row within-run A/B of an ADPF hint session on the swipe decoder thread.
